name: Collapse
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 5, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a magnet)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one corporeal creature or object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to hit the ground and take damage as if it had fallen from a height. The target is knocked prone and takes 1d6 falling damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the prone condition.
